description: Save a set of figures to the user's account, or update a saved one by passing its id from list_saved_filings. Figures in major units. The filing is saved even when validation finds problems, because a work in progress is worth keeping, and the problems come back in the response so you can raise them.

categoryTotals.description: Where the figures came from, when a bank statement fed them: signed major-unit totals per category code from categorise_transactions.

figures.description: The figures behind a small-company balance sheet. ALL amounts in major units.

cashAtBank.description: Bank balance at the year end. Negative means an overdraft.

cashAtBankPrior.description: Previous year-end bank balance. 0 for a first year.

creditorsWithinOneYear.description: Money the company owes, due within a year, expressed positive. Includes director loans owed back.

creditorsWithinOneYearPrior.description: Previous year creditors. 0 for a first year.

debtors.description: Money owed to the company at the year end.

debtorsPrior.description: Previous year debtors. 0 for a first year.

directorsLoan.description: How much of the creditors above is owed to the company's own directors. Part of that figure, never an addition to it. Usually the largest line on a one-person company's sheet, and repayable to the director free of tax.

directorsLoanPrior.description: Previous year directors' loan. 0 for a first year.

fixedAssets.description: Equipment and other fixed assets at net book value.

fixedAssetsPrior.description: Previous year fixed assets. 0 for a first year.

operatingCosts.description: Total running costs for the year, expressed positive.

operatingCostsPrior.description: Previous year operating costs. 0 for a first year.

shareCapital.description: Issued share capital or common stock, typically 1 to 100.

shareCapitalPrior.description: Previous year share capital. Usually the same as this year.

turnover.description: Sales income for the year, in major currency units (pounds/euros/dollars).

turnoverPrior.description: Previous year turnover. 0 for a first year.

id.description: Omit to create. Pass an id from list_saved_filings to update that filing.

identifiers.description: Register identifiers, e.g. {"companyNumber": "15379140"}. Tax references (UTR, EIN, TFN) are never stored and are silently dropped.

label.description: A name for the filing, e.g. "SparkGames year to 31 Dec 2025".

name: save_filing
